messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 6 December
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable from 07:00 to 13:00 on Saturday 6 December for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and check in any open documents before Friday close. Email and the case management system are unaffected.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
